project.title: CoworkingView
project.description:
CoworkingView packages.
cwv is the command-line client for the CoworkingView Price Index (flexible-office prices by city) and for coworking catalogue search. The program is MIT. The Price Index data it prints is CC BY 4.0.
Repository 16.0 is openSUSE Leap 16.0. The Open Build Service names Leap repositories by version (16.0), not openSUSE_Leap_16.0.
